decisions.rationale: May deployments trust one accountable coordinator for all writes, or must consumers distrust the producer? A direct Store handle is a real bypass unless governed externally.
Which recipients need independent program preservation, exact actual history, historical state safety, or authoritative current publication? These are separate claims.
Must a completely new actual-history consumer verify without replay and within 100ms, or may it pay explicit history/re-establishment cost? No option adopted.
Must a finished cryptographic proof precede every answer? Certification timing, logical commit and durable publication require separate explicit product choices.
Keep small semantic/assurance checking and proof transport behind separate interfaces; assess evidence before selecting or replacing a cryptographic backend.
